# Tula's International School - Best Boarding School in Dehradun

> Tula's International School is a premier co-educational **boarding school** in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. Known as the "Modern Gurukul," it is affiliated with CBSE and provides world-class residential education for Grades IV to XII. Admissions are open for the 2026-2027 academic session.

## Core Information
- **Website:** https://tis.edu.in/
- **Primary Keyword:** Best Boarding School in Dehradun, Uttarakhand
- **Admission Status:** Open for 2026-2027 (Classes IV–IX and XI)
- **Affiliation:** CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education)
- **Student-Teacher Ratio:** 1:5
- **Campus:** 22-acre residential campus in Selaqui, Dehradun.

## Important Links
- **Admission Procedure:** https://tis.edu.in/admission-procedure/
- **Fee Structure:** https://tis.edu.in/admission-procedure/fee-structure/
- **Frequently Asked Questions:** https://tis.edu.in/faq/
- **Contact Us:** https://tis.edu.in/contact-us/

## Admission Quick Facts
- **Registration Fee:** ₹15,000 (Non-refundable).
- **Timeline:** Registrations start in 1st March; forms should ideally be submitted by 30th September.
- **Selection:** Based on a written assessment and interaction with the Principal.
- **Session Starts:** First week of April every year.

## Boarding & Campus Life
- **Hostels:** Separate residential houses for boys and girls with modern amenities and 24/7 security.
- **Sports:** Football, Cricket, Squash, Basketball, and Horse Riding.
- **Concept:** Blends traditional Gurukul values with modern digital learning and global ethics.
